name: system-prompts
title_zh: RFC 2119 关键字压进每一行，提示词密度拉满
tagline_zh: 写模型要读的提示词、工具文档、Agent 定义时，它用项目标签约定 + RFC 2119 关键字把废话挤干。
tagline_en: For prompts, tool docs, agent defs: project tags + RFC 2119 keywords squeeze fluff. Outputs are half as long.
desc_en: Write system prompts, tool docs, and agent definitions. Project tag conventions + RFC 2119 keywords + dense compression. Use when authoring or editing any prompt the model reads.
why_zh: 不是给建议，是强制压缩：每个 MUST/SHOULD/MAY 都按 RFC 2119 定死语义。
why_en: It doesn't suggest—it compresses. RFC 2119 fixes semantics, tag conventions make context searchable, so the model stops guessing.
limit_zh: 只处理模型会读的文本（提示词/工具文档/Agent 定义），不碰面向用户的文案。需要你已有项目标签体系。
limit_en: Only for model-facing text (prompts/tool docs/agent defs), not user copy. Requires your own tag convention; without it, it only compresses keywords.
